name: tagged-stack
why: A tagged union of 26 overlapping tools, one boolean layer each. Every fuse splits the shared bottom face on the same domain, and until 2026-11-05 each split doubled the tag's face list (2^26 entries here; the saucer that found it fused 37 bumps one at a time and never finished). With the lineage kept unique it builds in the untagged time, under the 20 s budget this case states; before, 24 posts took 20.7 s and 26 did not finish. The posts nest — each is wider and taller than the one before — so the result is the plate and the last post: 8 faces, the shared bottom merged into one. The tag extents hold what each name owns, `plate` the 60 x 60 x 2 plate and `stack` the whole part; a face carried twice would not have moved them, a face lost would.
